title: Cowboys undrafted receiver Camden Brown follows strong training camp with two preseason TDs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys undrafted receiver Camden Brown follows strong training camp with two preseason TDs
sources.description: It's always an uphill battle for an undrafted rookie to make the team, but Cowboys wide receiver Camden Brown may be forcing his way onto the regular-season roster with his performance this summer.
